item.title: 1.0.0-beta.3
item.description:
# Cursor Switch 1.0 beta 3
More cursor choices and a refreshed native Mac appearance.
- A Safari-style pointing hand is now available under Shape, with customizable fill, outline, size, and click point. - Cursor type selection uses the native Liquid Glass tab picker on macOS 27, with native segmented controls on earlier systems. - A new layered hand-and-arrow app icon uses Icon Composer, with a fallback for older macOS versions. - About Cursor Switch shows the app logo, version/build, credits, and a link to josiah.io. - Browse symbols visually and search with words like “heart” or “hand”; entering a symbol name is optional. - The emoji input keeps one emoji at a time, including skin tones, flags, and combined emoji. - Drag the native glass selection between cursor types on macOS 27. - Cursor size now goes up to 120 pt, with gentle size-step feedback on supported Force Touch trackpads. - Open at login is a compact control in the header; About is available from the menu bar.
Custom cursors keep the same artwork over text and links. Cursor replacement uses a macOS compatibility layer; please report flicker, positioning issues, or trouble with fullscreen apps or multiple displays.
